title: Dan Deacon - Bromst - In The Studio
summary: A Pitchfork TV documentary following Dan Deacon in Montana as he finishes his album Bromst. It shows the experimentation behind it, including pieces written for MIDI-driven player pianos.
why: HN points to it in threads on black MIDI and player pianos as a look at an artist writing tuneful music beyond human playability.

quote.text: He talks about it quite in a bit in a Pitchfork TV video that documented him working on one of his albums, Bromst
